proposed_rules.trigger: On a download/template page, a full-width template preview image ([2x1]/[3x1]/[3x2], sometimes [bg:image]) is immediately followed by an 'Install Free Template App' button.
proposed_rules.decision: Model the preview image and the install CTA as ONE composite block (image cell + CTA cell), not as a separate image block plus a standalone CTA/default-content link.
proposed_rules.rationale: Rejected alternatives: (a) split into a generic image block and a separate CTA link, obscuring that the image and button perform one paired action; (b) fold it into the numbered-benefits grid above it, rejected because it is a visually distinct zone with a single-media content shape, not a repeating card grid.

provenance.evidence: C78 rc1c2c3 [2x1] preview + rc1c2c3c3 [bg:color] 'Install Free Template App'

proposed_rules.trigger: A full-width 'Get Started with Knack's ___' banner naming the specific template/app, positioned directly before the footer on template/download pages.
proposed_rules.decision: Treat as a reusable CTA banner block parametrized by template name, not page-unique free text.
proposed_rules.rationale: Identical structural position, size class, and wording pattern recur across all sampled download-template pages, indicating a shared component rather than one-off copy.
